snippet.title: Croc 2 Kingdom of the Gobbos Trailer
snippet.description:
Croc's back... and this time it's personal!

Join Croc as he sets off for the mainland in search of his long-lost parents, only to find his old nemesis Baron Dante revived by the Dantinis and out for revenge.

Explore four distinct villages, rescue captured Gobbos and take on an all-new cast of Guardians. All of Croc's classic moves are back, but jumping and tail-spinning are just the beginning. Croc can now triple jump, giving him extra height when he needs it most.

Race in cars and speedboats, ride minecarts, catch air on a hang glider, and take to the skies in a wooden airplane, across more than 40 levels of open-ended 3D platforming.

Croc 2 Kingdom of the Gobbos is coming to Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5, PlayStation 4, Xbox Series X, Xbox Series S, and Windows PC via Steam and GOG.com.

Wishlist now and be the first to know when Croc 2 Kingdom of the Gobbos launches!  Kapow!

PS5 / PS4: https://store.playstation.com/concept/10017913
Nintendo Switch (get notified): https://argonautgames.com/croc-2-remaster-switch
Xbox Series X|S: https://www.xbox.com/games/store/croc-2-kingdom-of-the-gobbos/9MWR2QK58LPQ/0010
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4198360
GOG.com: https://www.gog.com/game/croc_2_kingdom_of_the_gobbos
